caption:
Should you stretch after a massage? Gently, yes.

Many people feel looser for a few hours after a remedial massage. That's a handy window for an easy walk or the home exercises you've been given. If an area felt tender during treatment, keep it light for the rest of the day rather than stretching hard.

Massage and stretching can help you feel less tight, but strength and regular movement usually do more over time. Think of massage as one part of an active plan.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can suggest one or two aftercare stretches suited to what they find. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
